ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25:1 high-to-low intensity ratio; surface is predominantly dark-pigmented (low intensity) with sparse high-intensity (white/grey) mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light-grey mottling is concentrated along the distal-lateral regions of both lobes. A contiguous dark-pigmented region extends from the peduncle attachment through the central mid-section of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an approximate 75-degree internal angle and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. A prominent macro-scale irregular indentation (tissue loss) is located on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately convex sweep transitioning into upward-tapering tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (scars) are visible, particularly concentrated near the trailing edge of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe distal surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible crossing the light-grey mottled regions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation or notch on the upper-lateral margin of the right lobe, indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of high-intensity white spots at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe.
